tools.description: One order by its EXTERNAL reference, i.e. the order number from the connected shop or from your own import (for example 332-11-5599), with addresses, products with quantities (ordered, shipped, returned, refunded) and shipments with tracking numbers. Not the ZF reference: use zenfulfillment_list_ord

tools.name: zenfulfillment_list_stock
tools.description: Stock on hand in the Zenfulfillment warehouse per SKU (sku, quantity_on_stock). Filter by SKU text and/or a maximum quantity to find low stock (then sorted lowest first). GET /products/export.

tools.name: zenfulfillment_list_inventory_shipments
tools.description: List inbound inventory shipments (goods you sent to the warehouse) with reference, SKU lines, announced quantity, quantity arrived and note. Filter by ONE status, created/updated time or free text (ZF number, tracking code, type). Rows are grouped per shipment. Paging as in list_orders. GET /invento

tools.name: zenfulfillment_get_inventory_shipment
tools.description: One inbound inventory shipment by its ZF reference (for example ZF01123700): SKU lines with announced and arrived quantities and the note. GET /inventory_shipments/export/{reference}/reference.

tools.description: WRITE: send ONE order to the Zenfulfillment warehouse for picking, packing and shipping to the given address (fulfillment and shipping fees apply per the contract). tools.name: zenfulfillment_cancel_orders
tools.description: WRITE, cannot be undone: cancel orders by reference (up to 50). Only orders that can still be cancelled (before the warehouse has packed or shipped them) are cancelled; the others come back in `errors`. Confirm the references with the user first. POST /orders/cancel.

tools.name: zenfulfillment_mark_return_done
tools.description: WRITE: set a return's status to DONE (refunded) in Zenfulfillment. Zenfulfillment only records the status; refund the customer in your shop yourself. Use the `_id` from zenfulfillment_list_returns (not the ZF reference). Cannot be set back through the API. POST /returns/{returnId}/done.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: zenfulfillment_import_order · Private data: zenfulfillment_mark_return_done · Public sink: zenfulfillment_import_order, zenfulfillment_cancel_orders, zenfulfillment_mark_return_done.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: zenfulfillment_import_order · Private data: zenfulfillment_mark_return_done · Public sink: zenfulfillment_import_order, zenfulfillment_cancel_orders, zenfulfillment_mark_return_done

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
